title: Asynchronous message processing with AWS Lambda and IoT Core
description: API Gateway REST API integration with SQS, Lambda, and IoT

introBox.headline: How it works
text: A POST request to API Gateway will create a message onto a SQS queue. Lambda picks up the message uses the topic in the request body to send message to the IOT Data API endpoint
